title: Add desktop scaling modes to Android
changes: Add persistent Off, Nearest, Sharp and EPX world scaling choices, using desktop grid footprints and disabling the grid in EPX; keep Nearest as Android default.
validation: Mesa GLES compiled and linked both shaders and matched independent CPU reference samples for four scaling modes, edges, EPX grid disabling and three grid footprints in android-scaling-grid-reference-ozaacpls.
Android ARM64 Docker APK build and 27 Kotlin tests passed in android-desktop-scaling-apk-uobvsi4o; adb install -r updated the connected moto g34 5G.
limitations: Physical-device rendering, readability, GPU performance and complete desktop pixel equivalence remain unverified; other Android menu features are still missing.
